ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Meeem
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ الۡكِتٰبُ لَا رَيۡبَۛۚۖ فِيۡهِۛۚ هُدًي لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Zaalikal Kitaabu laa raiba feeh; udal lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيۡمُوۡنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yu'minoona bilghaibi wa yuqeemoonas salaata wa mimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.en: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡكَ وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَۚ وَبِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilaika wa maaa unzila min qablika wa bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
ayahs.en: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ عَلٰي هُدًي مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡࣗ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzar tahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

ayahs.ar: خَتَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَعَلٰي سَمۡعِهِمۡؕ وَعَلٰ٘ي اَبۡصَارِهِمۡ غِشَاوَةٌؗ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Khatamal laahu 'alaa quloobihim wa 'alaa sam'i-him wa 'alaaa absaarihim ghishaa watunw wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: Allah has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَبِالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِ وَمَا هُمۡ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa minan naasi mai yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi wa bil yawmil aakhiri wa maa hum bimu'mineen
ayahs.en: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allah and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

ayahs.ar: يُخٰدِعُوۡنَ اللّٰهَ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاۚ وَمَا يَخۡدَعُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yukhaadi'oonal laaha wallazeena aamanoo wa maa yakhda'oona illaaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

ayahs.ar: فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ مَّرَضٌۙ فَزَادَهُمُ اللّٰهُ مَرَضًاۚ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌۭ࣢ۙ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡذِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fee quloobihim mara dun fazzdahumul laahu maradan wa lahum 'azaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakziboon
ayahs.en: In their hearts is disease, so Allah has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ لَا تُفۡسِدُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil ardi qaalo innamaa nahnu muslihoon
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ الۡمُفۡسِدُوۡنَ وَلٰكِنۡ لَّا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alaaa innahum humul mufsidoona wa laakil laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اٰمِنُوۡا كَمَا٘ اٰمَنَ النَّاسُ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَنُؤۡمِنُ كَمَا٘ اٰمَنَ السُّفَهَآءُؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ هُمُ السُّفَهَآءُ وَلٰكِنۡ لَّا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahum aaminoo kamaaa aamanan naasu qaalooo anu'minu kamaaa aamanas sufahaaa'; alaaa innahum humus sufahaaa'u wa laakil laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا لَقُوا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّاۚۖ وَاِذَا خَلَوۡا اِلٰي شَيٰطِيۡنِهِمۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا مَعَكُمۡۙ اِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa laqul lazeena aamanoo qaalooo aamannaa wa izaa khalw ilaa shayaateenihim qaalooo innaa ma'akum innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
ayahs.en: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ يَسۡتَهۡزِئُ بِهِمۡ وَيَمُدُّهُمۡ فِيۡ طُغۡيَانِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allahu yastahzi'u bihim wa yamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
ayahs.en: [But] Allah mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اشۡتَرَوُا الضَّلٰلَةَ بِالۡهُدٰيࣕ فَمَا رَبِحَتۡ تِّجَارَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُوۡا مُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeenash tara wud dalaalata bilhudaa famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum wa maa kaanoo muhtadeen
ayahs.en: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُهُمۡ كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي اسۡتَوۡقَدَ نَارًاۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَضَآءَتۡ مَا حَوۡلَهٗ ذَهَبَ اللّٰهُ بِنُوۡرِهِمۡ وَتَرَكَهُمۡ فِيۡ ظُلُمٰتٍ لَّا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Masaluhum kamasalillazis tawqada naaran falammaaa adaaa'at maa hawlahoo zahabal laahu binoorihim wa tarakahum fee zulumaatil laa yubsiroon
ayahs.en: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allah took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

ayahs.ar: صُمٌّۭ بُكۡمٌ عُمۡيٌ فَهُمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summum bukmun 'umyun fahum laa yarji'oon
ayahs.en: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فِيۡهِ ظُلُمٰتٌ وَّرَعۡدٌ وَّبَرۡقٌۚ يَجۡعَلُوۡنَ اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الۡمَوۡتِؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُحِيۡطٌۭ بِالۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Aw kasaiyibim minas samaaa'i feehi zulumaatunw wa ra'dunw wa barq, yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum feee aazaanihim minas sawaa'iqi hazaral mawt' wallaahu muheetum bilkaafireen
ayahs.en: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: يَكَادُ الۡبَرۡقُ يَخۡطَفُ اَبۡصَارَهُمۡؕ كُلَّمَا٘ اَضَآءَ لَهُمۡ مَّشَوۡا فِيۡهِࣗۙ وَاِذَا٘ اَظۡلَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَامُوۡاؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصَارِهِمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yakaadul barqu yakhtafu absaarahum kullamaaa adaaa'a lahum mashaw feehi wa izaaa azlama 'alaihim qaamoo; wa law shaaa'al laahu lazahaba bisam'ihim wa absaarihim; innal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعۡبُدُوۡا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa aiyuhan naasu'budoo Rabbakumul lazee khalaqakum wallazeena min qablikum la'allakum tattaqoon
ayahs.en: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فِرَاشًا وَّالسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًࣕ وَّاَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَخۡرَجَ بِهٖ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزۡقًا لَّكُمۡۚ فَلَا تَجۡعَلُوۡا لِلّٰهِ اَنۡدَادًا وَّاَنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda firaashanw wassamaaa'a binaaa 'anw wa anzala minassamaaa'i maaa'an fa akhraja bihee minas samaraati rizqal lakum falaa taj'aloo lillaahi andaadanw wa antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡ رَيۡبٍ مِّمَّا نَزَّلۡنَا عَلٰي عَبۡدِنَا فَاۡتُوۡا بِسُوۡرَةٍ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖࣕ وَادۡعُوۡا شُهَدَآءَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in kuntum fee raibim mimmaa nazzalnaa 'alaa 'abdinaa fatoo bi Sooratim mim mislihee wad'oo shuhadaaa'akum min doonil laahi in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down upon Our Servant [Muhammad], then produce a surah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses other than Allah, if you should be truthful.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تَفۡعَلُوۡا وَلَنۡ تَفۡعَلُوۡا فَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِيۡ وَقُوۡدُهَا النَّاسُ وَالۡحِجَارَةُۚۖ اُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fail lam taf'aloo wa lan taf'aloo fattaqun Naaral latee waqooduhan naasu walhijaaratu u'iddat lilkaafireen
ayahs.en: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَبَشِّرِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ كُلَّمَا رُزِقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مِنۡ ثَمَرَةٍ رِّزۡقًاۙ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ رُزِقۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَاُتُوۡا بِهٖ مُتَشَابِهًاؕ وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا٘ اَزۡوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa bashshiril lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati anna lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru kullamaa riziqoo minhaa min samaratir rizqan qaaloo haazal lazee ruziqnaa min qablu wa utoo bihee mutashaabihaa, wa lahum feehaaa azwaajum mutahhara tunw wa hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَسۡتَحۡيٖ٘ اَنۡ يَّضۡرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوۡضَةً فَمَا فَوۡقَهَاؕ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا فَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡۚ وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَاذَا٘ اَرَادَ اللّٰهُ بِهٰذَا مَثَلًاۘ يُضِلُّ بِهٖ كَثِيۡرًا وَّيَهۡدِيۡ بِهٖ كَثِيۡرًاؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا الۡفٰسِقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha laa yastahyeee ai yadriba masalam maa ba'oodatan famaa fawqahaa; faammal lazeena aamanoo faya'lamoona annahul haqqu mir rabbihim wa ammal lazeena kafaroo fayaqooloona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; yudillu bihee kaseeranw wa yahdee bihee kaseeraa; wa maa yudillu biheee illal faasiqeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَنۡقُضُوۡنَ عَهۡدَ اللّٰهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مِيۡثَاقِهٖࣕ وَيَقۡطَعُوۡنَ مَا٘ اَمَرَ اللّٰهُ بِهٖ٘ اَنۡ يُّوۡصَلَ وَيُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yanqudoona 'ahdal laahi mim ba'di meesaaqihee wa yaqt'oona maaa amaral laahu biheee ai yoosala wa yufsidoona fil ard; ulaaa'ika hum khaasirron
ayahs.en: Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it and sever that which Allah has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

ayahs.ar: كَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَكُنۡتُمۡ اَمۡوَاتًا فَاَحۡيَاكُمۡۚ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kaifa takfuroona billaahi wa kuntum amwaatan fa ahyaakum summa yumeetukum summa yuhyeekum summaa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: How can you disbelieve in Allah when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ مَّا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًاࣗ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰ٘ي اِلَي السَّمَآءِ فَسَوّٰىهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee khalaqa lakum maa fil ardi jamee'an summas tawaaa ilas samaaa'i fasaw waahunna sab'a samaa waat; wa Huwa bikulli shai'in Aleem
ayahs.en: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اِنِّيۡ جَاعِلٌ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ خَلِيۡفَةًؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَتَجۡعَلُ فِيۡهَا مَنۡ يُّفۡسِدُ فِيۡهَا وَيَسۡفِكُ الدِّمَآءَۚ وَنَحۡنُ نُسَبِّحُ بِحَمۡدِكَ وَنُقَدِّسُ لَكَؕ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala rabbuka lil malaaa'ikati innee jaa'ilun fil ardi khaleefatan qaalooo ataj'alu feehaa mai yufsidu feehaa wa yasfikud dimaaa'a wa nahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wa nuqaddisu laka qaala inneee a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we declare Your praise and sanctify You?" Allah said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَّمَ اٰدَمَ الۡاَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا ثُمَّ عَرَضَهُمۡ عَلَي الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ فَقَالَ اَنۭۡ بِـُٔوۡنِيۡ بِاَسۡمَآءِ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa 'allama Aadamal asmaaa'a kullahaa summa 'aradahum 'alal malaaa'ikati faqaala ambi'oonee bias maaa'i haaa'ulaaa'i in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ لَا عِلۡمَ لَنَا٘ اِلَّا مَا عَلَّمۡتَنَاؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaaa illaa maa 'allamtanaaa innaka antal'aleemul hakeem
ayahs.en: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰ٘اٰدَمُ اَنۭۡ بِئۡهُمۡ بِاَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اَنۭۡ بَاَهُمۡ بِاَسۡمَآئِهِمۡۙ قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكُمۡ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ غَيۡبَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِۙ وَاَعۡلَمُ مَا تُبۡدُوۡنَ وَمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaaa Aadamu ambi' hum biasmaaa'ihimfalammaaa amba ahum bi asmaaa'ihim qaala alam aqul lakum inneee a'lamu ghaibas samaawaati wal ardi wa a'lamu maa tubdoona wa maa kuntum taktumoon
ayahs.en: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ اَبٰي وَاسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qulnaa lilmalaaa'i katis judoo liAadama fasajadooo illaaa Ibleesa abaa wastakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَقُلۡنَا يٰ٘اٰدَمُ اسۡكُنۡ اَنۡتَ وَزَوۡجُكَ الۡجَنَّةَ وَكُلَا مِنۡهَا رَغَدًا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمَاࣕ وَلَا تَقۡرَبَا هٰذِهِ الشَّجَرَةَ فَتَكُوۡنَا مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qulnaa yaaa Aadamus kun anta wa zawjukal jannata wa kulaa minhaa raghadan haisu shi'tumaa wa laa taqabaa haazihish shajarata fatakoonaa minaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَزَلَّهُمَا الشَّيۡطٰنُ عَنۡهَا فَاَخۡرَجَهُمَا مِمَّا كَانَا فِيۡهِࣕ وَقُلۡنَا اهۡبِطُوۡا بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ وَلَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرٌّ وَّمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Fa azallahumash Shaitaanu 'anhaa fa akhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa fee wa qulnah bitoo ba'dukum liba'din 'aduwwunw wa lakum fil ardi mustaqarrunw wa mataa'un ilaa heen
ayahs.en: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

ayahs.ar: فَتَلَقّٰ٘ي اٰدَمُ مِنۡ رَّبِّهٖ كَلِمٰتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Fatalaqqaaa Aadamu mir Rabbihee Kalimaatin fataaba 'alayh; innahoo Huwat Tawwaabur Raheem
ayahs.en: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡنَا اهۡبِطُوۡا مِنۡهَا جَمِيۡعًاۚ فَاِمَّا يَاۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ مِّنِّيۡ هُدًي فَمَنۡ تَبِعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qulnah bitoo minhaa jamee 'an fa immaa yaatiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabi'a hudaaya falaa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahza noon
ayahs.en: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا٘ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena kafaroo wa kaz zabooo bi aayaatinaa ulaaa'ika Ashaabun Naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتِيَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَاَوۡفُوۡا بِعَهۡدِيۡ٘ اُوۡفِ بِعَهۡدِكُمۡۚ وَاِيَّايَ فَارۡهَبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eelaz kuroo ni'matiyal lateee an'amtu 'alaikum wa awfoo bi'Ahdeee oofi bi ahdikum wa iyyaaya farhaboon
ayahs.en: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰمِنُوۡا بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡ٘ا اَوَّلَ كَافِرٍۭ بِهٖࣕ وَلَا تَشۡتَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِيۡ ثَمَنًا قَلِيۡلًاؗ وَّاِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa aaminoo bimaaa anzaltu musaddiqal limaa ma'akum wa laa takoonooo awwala kaafirim bihee wa laa tashtaroo bi Aayaatee samanan qaleelanw wa iyyaaya fattaqoon
ayahs.en: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَلۡبِسُوا الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُوا الۡحَقَّ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa talbisul haqqa bilbaatili wa taktumul haqqa wa antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

ayahs.ar: وَاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَارۡكَعُوۡا مَعَ الرّٰكِعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata warka'oo ma'ar raaki'een
ayahs.en: And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].

ayahs.ar: اَتَاۡمُرُوۡنَ النَّاسَ بِالۡبِرِّ وَتَنۡسَوۡنَ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَتۡلُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ataamuroonan naasa bilbirri wa tansawna anfusakum wa antum tatloonal Kitaab; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: وَاسۡتَعِيۡنُوۡا بِالصَّبۡرِ وَالصَّلٰوةِؕ وَاِنَّهَا لَكَبِيۡرَةٌ اِلَّا عَلَي الۡخٰشِعِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wasta'eenoo bissabri was Salaah; wa innahaa lakabee ratun illaa alal khaashi'een
ayahs.en: And seek help through patience and prayer, and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allah]

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَظُنُّوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّلٰقُوۡا رَبِّهِمۡ وَاَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِ رٰجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yazunnoona annahum mulaaqoo Rabbihim wa annahum ilaihi raaji'oon
ayahs.en: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتِيَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَاَنِّيۡ فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eelaz kuroo ni'matiyal lateee an'amtu 'alaikum wa annee faddaltukum 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّقُوۡا يَوۡمًا لَّا تَجۡزِيۡ نَفۡسٌ عَنۡ نَّفۡسٍ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَّلَا يُؤۡخَذُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٌ وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wattaqoo Yawmal laa tajzee nafsun 'an nafsin shai'anw wa laa yuqbalu minhaa shafaa'atunw wa laa yu'khazu minhaa 'adlunw wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ نَجَّيۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۡ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُوۡمُوۡنَكُمۡ سُوۡٓءَ الۡعَذَابِ يُذَبِّحُوۡنَ اَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُوۡنَ نِسَآءَكُمۡؕ وَفِيۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ بَلَآءٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz najjainaakum min Aali Fir'awna yasoomoonakum sooo'al azaabi yuzabbihoona abuaaa'akum wa yastahyoona nisaaa'akum; wa fee zaalikum balaaa'um mir Rabbikum 'azeem
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We saved your forefathers from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ فَرَقۡنَا بِكُمُ الۡبَحۡرَ فَاَنۡجَيۡنٰكُمۡ وَاَغۡرَقۡنَا٘ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَنۡظُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz faraqnaa bikumul bahra fa anjainaakum wa agh-raqnaaa Aala Fir'awna wa antum tanzuroon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ وٰعَدۡنَا مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَرۡبَعِيۡنَ لَيۡلَةً ثُمَّ اتَّخَذۡتُمُ الۡعِجۡلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ وَاَنۡتُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz waa'adnaa Moosaaa arba'eena lailatan summattakhaztumul 'ijla mim ba'dihee wa antum zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him, while you were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ عَفَوۡنَا عَنۡكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa 'afawnaa 'ankum mim ba'di zaalika la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡفُرۡقَانَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz aatainaa Moosal kitaaba wal Furqaana la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِقَوۡمِهٖ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنَّكُمۡ ظَلَمۡتُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ بِاتِّخَاذِكُمُ الۡعِجۡلَ فَتُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي بَارِئِكُمۡ فَاقۡتُلُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَكُمۡؕ ذٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ عِنۡدَ بَارِئِكُمۡؕ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Moosaa liqawmihee yaa qawmi innakum zalamtum anfusakum bittikhaa zikumul 'ijla fatoobooo ilaa Baari'ikum faqtulooo anfusakum zaalikum khairul lakum 'inda Baari'ikum fataaba 'alaikum; innahoo Huwat Tawwaabur Raheem
ayahs.en: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يٰمُوۡسٰي لَنۡ نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتّٰي نَرَي اللّٰهَ جَهۡرَةً فَاَخَذَتۡكُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَنۡظُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qultum yaa Moosaa lan nu'mina laka hattaa naral laaha jahratan fa akhazat kumus saa'iqatu wa antum tanzuroon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنٰكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَوۡتِكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa ba'asnaakum mim ba'di mawtikum la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَظَلَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡغَمَامَ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَنَّ وَالسَّلۡوٰيؕ كُلُوۡا مِنۡ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡؕ وَمَا ظَلَمُوۡنَا وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa zallalnaa 'alaikumul ghamaama wa anzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was Salwaa kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa maa zalamoonaa wa laakin kaanooo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا ادۡخُلُوۡا هٰذِهِ الۡقَرۡيَةَ فَكُلُوۡا مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ شِئۡتُمۡ رَغَدًا وَّادۡخُلُوا الۡبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَّقُوۡلُوۡا حِطَّةٌ نَّغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ خَطٰيٰكُمۡؕ وَسَنَزِيۡدُ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qulnad khuloo haazihil qaryata fakuloo minhaa haisu shi'tum raghadanw wadkhulul baaba sujjadanw wa qooloo hittatun naghfir lakum khataayaakum; wa sanazeedul muhsineen
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens.' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

ayahs.ar: فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا قَوۡلًا غَيۡرَ الَّذِيۡ قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ فَاَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا رِجۡزًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡسُقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fabaddalal lazeena zalamoo qawlan ghairal lazee qeela lahum fa anzalnaa 'alal lazeena zalamoo rijzam minas samaaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
ayahs.en: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذِ اسۡتَسۡقٰي مُوۡسٰي لِقَوۡمِهٖ فَقُلۡنَا اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاكَ الۡحَجَرَؕ فَانۡفَجَرَتۡ مِنۡهُ اثۡنَتَا عَشۡرَةَ عَيۡنًاؕ قَدۡ عَلِمَ كُلُّ اُنَاسٍ مَّشۡرَبَهُمۡؕ كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izis tasqaa Moosaa liqawmihee faqulnad rib bi'asaakal hajara fanfajarat minhusnataaa 'ashrata 'aynan qad 'alima kullu unaasim mash rabahum kuloo washraboo mir rizqil laahi wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
ayahs.en: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يٰمُوۡسٰي لَنۡ نَّصۡبِرَ عَلٰي طَعَامٍ وَّاحِدٍ فَادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخۡرِجۡ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۭۡ بِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ مِنۭۡ بَقۡلِهَا وَقِثَّآئِهَا وَفُوۡمِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَاؕ قَالَ اَتَسۡتَبۡدِلُوۡنَ الَّذِيۡ هُوَ اَدۡنٰي بِالَّذِيۡ هُوَ خَيۡرٌؕ اِهۡبِطُوۡا مِصۡرًا فَاِنَّ لَكُمۡ مَّا سَاَلۡتُمۡؕ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالۡمَسۡكَنَةُ وَبَآءُوۡ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقۡتُلُوۡنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّؕ ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوۡا وَّكَانُوۡا يَعۡتَدُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qultum yaa Moosaa lan nasbira 'alaa ta'aaminw waahidin fad'u lanaa rabbaka yukhrij lanaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu mimbaqlihaa wa qis saaa'ihaa wa foomihaa wa 'adasihaa wa basalihaa qaala atastabdiloonal lazee huwa adnaa billazee huwa khayr; ihbitoo misran fa inna lakum maa sa altum; wa duribat 'alaihimuz zillatu walmaskanatu wa baaa'oo bighadabim minal laah; zaalika bi annahum kaano yakfuroona bi aayaatil laahi wa yaqtuloonan Nabiyyeena bighairil haqq; zaalika bimaa 'asaw wa kaanoo ya'tadoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَالَّذِيۡنَ هَادُوۡا وَالنَّصٰرٰي وَالصّٰبِـِٕيۡنَ مَنۡ اٰمَنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلَهُمۡ اَجۡرُهُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡۚࣕ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wallazeena haadoo wan nasaaraa was Saabi'eena man aamana billaahi wal yawmil aakhiri wa 'amila saalihan falahum ajruhum 'inda Rabbihim wa laa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahzanoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muhammad] - those [among them] who believed in Allah and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذۡنَا مِيۡثَاقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ الطُّوۡرَؕ خُذُوۡا مَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰكُمۡ بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاذۡكُرُوۡا مَا فِيۡهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhaznaa meesaaqakum wa rafa'naa fawqakumut Toora khuzoo maaa aatainaakum biquwwatinw wazkuroo maa feehi la'allakum tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَۚ فَلَوۡلَا فَضۡلُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَرَحۡمَتُهٗ لَكُنۡتُمۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa tawallaitum mim ba'di zaalika falawlaa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo lakuntum minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمُ الَّذِيۡنَ اعۡتَدَوۡا مِنۡكُمۡ فِي السَّبۡتِ فَقُلۡنَا لَهُمۡ كُوۡنُوۡا قِرَدَةً خٰسِـِٕيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad 'alimtumul lazeena'-tadaw minkum fis Sabti faqulnaa lahum koonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
ayahs.en: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلۡنٰهَا نَكَالًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهَا وَمَا خَلۡفَهَا وَمَوۡعِظَةً لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faja'alnaahaa nakaalal limaa baina yadihaa wa maa khalfahaa wa maw'izatal lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰي لِقَوۡمِهٖ٘ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَاۡمُرُكُمۡ اَنۡ تَذۡبَحُوۡا بَقَرَةًؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَتَتَّخِذُنَا هُزُوًاؕ قَالَ اَعُوۡذُ بِاللّٰهِ اَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Moosaa liqawmiheee innal laaha yaamurukum an tazbahoo baqaratan qaalooo atattakhizunna huzuwan qaala a'oozu billaahi an akoona minal jaahileen
ayahs.en: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allah commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allah from being among the ignorant."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنۡ لَّنَا مَا هِيَؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوۡلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَّلَا بِكۡرٌؕ عَوَانٌۭ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَؕ فَافۡعَلُوۡا مَا تُؤۡمَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalud-'u lanaa rabbaka yubaiyil lanaa maa hee; qaala innahoo yaqoolu innahaa baqaratul laa faaridunw wa laa bikrun 'awaanum baina zaalika faf'aloo maa tu'maroon
ayahs.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allah] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنۡ لَّنَا مَا لَوۡنُهَاؕ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوۡلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ صَفۡرَآءُۙ فَاقِعٌ لَّوۡنُهَا تَسُرُّ النّٰظِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalud-'u lanaa rabaaka yubaiyil lanaa maa lawnuhaa; qaala innahoo yaqoolu innahaa baqaratun safraaa'u faqi'ul lawnuhaa tasurrunnaazireen
ayahs.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنۡ لَّنَا مَا هِيَۙ اِنَّ الۡبَقَرَ تَشٰبَهَ عَلَيۡنَاؕ وَاِنَّا٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalud-'u lanaa rabbaka yubaiyil lanaa maa hiya innal baqara tashaabaha 'alainaa wa innaaa in shaaa'al laahu lamuhtadoon
ayahs.en: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّهٗ يَقُوۡلُ اِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُوۡلٌ تُثِيۡرُ الۡاَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِي الۡحَرۡثَۚ مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيۡهَاؕ قَالُوا الۡـٰٔنَ جِئۡتَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ فَذَبَحُوۡهَا وَمَا كَادُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala innahoo yaqoolu innahaa baqaratul laa zaloolun tuseerul arda wa laa tasqil harsa musallamatullaa shiyata feehaa; qaalul 'aana jita bilhaqq; fazabahoohaa wa maa kaado yaf'aloon
ayahs.en: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَتَلۡتُمۡ نَفۡسًا فَادّٰرَءۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَاؕ وَاللّٰهُ مُخۡرِجٌ مَّا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡتُمُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qataltum nafsan faddaara'tum feehaa wallaahu mukrijum maa kuntum taktumoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allah was to bring out that which you were concealing.

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡنَا اضۡرِبُوۡهُ بِبَعۡضِهَاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُحۡيِ اللّٰهُ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَيُرِيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faqulnad riboohu biba'dihaa; kazaalika yuhyil laa hul mawtaa wa yureekum aayaatihee la'allakum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قَسَتۡ قُلُوۡبُكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ فَهِيَ كَالۡحِجَارَةِ اَوۡ اَشَدُّ قَسۡوَةًؕ وَاِنَّ مِنَ الۡحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنۡهُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُؕ وَاِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخۡرُجُ مِنۡهُ الۡمَآءُؕ وَاِنَّ مِنۡهَا لَمَا يَهۡبِطُ مِنۡ خَشۡيَةِ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa qasat quloobukum mim ba'di zaalika fahiya kalhijaarati aw-ashaadu qaswah; wa inna minal hijaarati lamaa yatafajjaru minhul anhaar; wa inna minhaa lamaa yash shaqqaqu fayakhruju minhul maaa'; wa inna minhaa lamaa yahbitu min khashyatil laa; wa mal laahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

ayahs.ar: اَفَتَطۡمَعُوۡنَ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡا لَكُمۡ وَقَدۡ كَانَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ كَلٰمَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُوۡنَهٗ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا عَقَلُوۡهُ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afatatma'oona ai yu'minoo lakum wa qad kaana fareequm minhum yasma'oona Kalaamal laahi summa yuharri foonahoo mim ba'di maa'aqaloohu wa hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allah and then distort the Torah after they had understood it while they were knowing?

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا لَقُوا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّاۚۖ وَاِذَا خَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ اِلٰي بَعۡضٍ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَتُحَدِّثُوۡنَهُمۡ بِمَا فَتَحَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِيُحَآجُّوۡكُمۡ بِهٖ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa laqul lazeena aamanoo qaalooo aamannaa wa izaakhalaa ba'duhum ilaa ba'din qaalooo atuhaddisoonahum bimaa fatahal laahu 'alaikum liyuhaajjookum bihee 'inda rabbikum; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allah has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awalaa ya'lamoona annal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.en: But do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare?

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡهُمۡ اُمِّيُّوۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا٘ اَمَانِيَّ وَاِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa minhum ummiyyoona laa ya'lamoonal kitaaba illaaa amaaniyya wa in hum illaa yazunnoon
ayahs.en: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

ayahs.ar: فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِاَيۡدِيۡهِمۡࣗ ثُمَّ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هٰذَا مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ لِيَشۡتَرُوۡا بِهٖ ثَمَنًا قَلِيۡلًاؕ فَوَيۡلٌ لَّهُمۡ مِّمَّا كَتَبَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَوَيۡلٌ لَّهُمۡ مِّمَّا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fawailul lillazeena yaktuboonal kitaaba bi aydddhim summa yaqooloona haazaa min 'indil laahi liyashtaroo bihee samanan qaleelan fawilul lahum mimaa katabat aydeehim wa wailul lahum mimmaa yaksiboon
ayahs.en: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allah," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَنۡ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّا٘ اَيَّامًا مَّعۡدُوۡدَةًؕ قُلۡ اَتَّخَذۡتُمۡ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ عَهۡدًا فَلَنۡ يُّخۡلِفَ اللّٰهُ عَهۡدَهٗ٘ اَمۡ تَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo lan tamassanan Naaru illaaa ayyaamam ma'doo dah; qul attakhaztum 'indal laahi 'ahdan falai yukhlifal laahu 'ahdahooo am taqooloona 'alal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for a few days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allah? For Allah will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allah that which you do not know?"

ayahs.ar: بَلٰي مَنۡ كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةً وَّاَحَاطَتۡ بِهٖ خَطِيۡٓـَٔتُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balaa man kasaba sayyi'atanw wa ahaatat bihee khateee'atuhoo fa-ulaaa'ika Ashaabun Naari hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati ulaaa'ika Ashaabul Jannati hum feeha khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذۡنَا مِيۡثَاقَ بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ لَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَࣞ وَبِالۡوَالِدَيۡنِ اِحۡسَانًا وَّذِي الۡقُرۡبٰي وَالۡيَتٰمٰي وَالۡمَسٰكِيۡنِ وَقُوۡلُوۡا لِلنَّاسِ حُسۡنًا وَّاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَؕ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّنۡكُمۡ وَاَنۡتُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhaznaa meesaaqa Baneee Israaa'eela laa ta'budoona illal laaha wa bil waalidaini ihsaananw wa zil qurbaa walyataamaa walmasaakeeni wa qooloo linnaasi husnanw wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuzZakaata summa tawallitum illaa qaleelam minkum wa antum mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allah; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakah." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذۡنَا مِيۡثَاقَكُمۡ لَا تَسۡفِكُوۡنَ دِمَآءَكُمۡ وَلَا تُخۡرِجُوۡنَ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دِيَارِكُمۡ ثُمَّ اَقۡرَرۡتُمۡ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhaznaa meesaa qakum laa tasfikoona dimaaa'akum wa laa tukrijoona anfusakum min diyaarikum summa aqrartum wa antum tashhadoon
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed each other's blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡتُمۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ تَقۡتُلُوۡنَ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡ وَتُخۡرِجُوۡنَ فَرِيۡقًا مِّنۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ دِيَارِهِمۡؗ تَظٰهَرُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِالۡاِثۡمِ وَالۡعُدۡوَانِؕ وَاِنۡ يَّاۡتُوۡكُمۡ اُسٰرٰي تُفٰدُوۡهُمۡ وَهُوَ مُحَرَّمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجُهُمۡؕ اَفَتُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِبَعۡضِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِبَعۡضٍۚ فَمَا جَزَآءُ مَنۡ يَّفۡعَلُ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡكُمۡ اِلَّا خِزۡيٌ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يُرَدُّوۡنَ اِلٰ٘ي اَشَدِّ الۡعَذَابِؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa antum haaa'ulaaa'i taqtuloona anfusakum wa tukhrijoona fareeqam minkum min diyaarihim tazaaharoona 'alaihim bil ismi wal'udwaani wa iny yaatookum usaaraa tufaadoohum wahuwa muharramun 'alaikum ikhraajuhum; afatu' mi-noona biba'dil Kitaabi wa takfuroona biba'd; famaa jazaaa'u mai yaf'alu zaalika minkum illaa khizyun fil hayaatid-dunyaa wa yawmal qiyaamati yuraddoona ilaaa ashaddil 'azaab; wa mal laahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ اشۡتَرَوُا الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا بِالۡاٰخِرَةِؗ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeenash tarawul hayaatad dunyaa bil aakhirati falaa yukhaffafu 'anhumul 'azaabu wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ وَقَفَّيۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ بِالرُّسُلِؗ وَاٰتَيۡنَا عِيۡسَي ابۡنَ مَرۡيَمَ الۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَاَيَّدۡنٰهُ بِرُوۡحِ الۡقُدُسِؕ اَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌۭ بِمَا لَا تَهۡوٰ٘ي اَنۡفُسُكُمُ اسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡۚ فَفَرِيۡقًا كَذَّبۡتُمۡؗ وَفَرِيۡقًا تَقۡتُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba wa qaffainaa mim ba'dihee bir Rusuli wa aatainaa 'Eesab-na-Maryamal baiyinaati wa ayyadnaahu bi Roohil Qudus; afakullamaa jaaa'akum Rasoolum bimaa laa tahwaaa anfusukumus takbartum fafareeqan kazzabtum wa fareeqan taqtuloon
ayahs.en: And We did certainly give Moses the Torah and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا قُلُوۡبُنَا غُلۡفٌؕ بَلۡ لَّعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡ فَقَلِيۡلًا مَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo quloobunaa ghulf; bal la'anahumul laahu bikufrihim faqaleelam maa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allah has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ كِتٰبٌ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡۙ وَكَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ يَسۡتَفۡتِحُوۡنَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡاۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ مَّا عَرَفُوۡا كَفَرُوۡا بِهٖؗ فَلَعۡنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'ahum Kitaabum min 'indil laahi musaddiqul limaa ma'ahum wa kaanoo min qablu yastaftihoona 'alal lazeena kafaroo falammaa jaaa'ahum maa 'arafoo kafaroo bih; fala 'natul laahi 'alal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And when there came to them a Book from Allah confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allah will be upon the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: بِئۡسَمَا اشۡتَرَوۡا بِهٖ٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ اَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ بَغۡيًا اَنۡ يُّنَزِّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖۚ فَبَآءُوۡ بِغَضَبٍ عَلٰي غَضَبٍؕ وَلِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Bi'samash taraw biheee anfusahum ai yakfuroo bimaaa anzalal laahu baghyan ai yunazzilal laahu min fadlilhee 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min ibaadihee fabaaa'oo bighadabin 'alaa ghadab; wa lilkaafireena 'azaabum muheen
ayahs.en: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allah has revealed through [their] outrage that Allah would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اٰمِنُوۡا بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ قَالُوۡا نُؤۡمِنُ بِمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا وَيَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِمَا وَرَآءَهٗࣗ وَهُوَ الۡحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡؕ قُلۡ فَلِمَ تَقۡتُلُوۡنَ اَنۭۡ بِيَآءَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahum aaminoo bimaaa anzalal laahu qaaloo nu'minu bimaaa unzila 'alainaa wa yakfuroona bimaa waraaa'ahoo wa huwal haqqu musaddiqal limaa ma'ahum; qul falima taqtuloona Ambiyaaa'al laahi min qablu in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allah before, if you are [indeed] believers?"

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّخَذۡتُمُ الۡعِجۡلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ وَاَنۡتُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'akum Moosa bilbaiyinaati summat takhaztunmul 'ijla mim ba'dihee wa antum zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذۡنَا مِيۡثَاقَكُمۡ وَرَفَعۡنَا فَوۡقَكُمُ الطُّوۡرَؕ خُذُوۡا مَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰكُمۡ بِقُوَّةٍ وَّاسۡمَعُوۡاؕ قَالُوۡا سَمِعۡنَا وَعَصَيۡنَاࣗ وَاُشۡرِبُوۡا فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمُ الۡعِجۡلَ بِكُفۡرِهِمۡؕ قُلۡ بِئۡسَمَا يَاۡمُرُكُمۡ بِهٖ٘ اِيۡمَانُكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhaznaa meesaaqakum wa rafa'naa fawqa kumut Toora khuzoo maaa aatainaakum biquwwatinw wasma'oo qaaloo sami'naa wa 'asainaa wa ushriboo fee quloobihimul 'ijla bikufrihim; qul bi'samaa yaamurukum biheee eemaanukum in kuntum m'mineen
ayahs.en: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَتۡ لَكُمُ الدَّارُ الۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ خَالِصَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ النَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا الۡمَوۡتَ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul in kaanat lakumud Daarul Aakhiratu 'indal laahi khaalisatam min doonin naasi fatamannawul mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allah is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَنۡ يَّتَمَنَّوۡهُ اَبَدًاۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِالظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lai yatamannawhu abadam bimaa qaddamat aydeehim; wallaahu 'aleemum bizzaalimeen
ayahs.en: But they will never wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allah is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَتَجِدَنَّهُمۡ اَحۡرَصَ النَّاسِ عَلٰي حَيٰوةٍۚۛ وَمِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡاۚۛ يَوَدُّ اَحَدُهُمۡ لَوۡ يُعَمَّرُ اَلۡفَ سَنَةٍۚ وَمَا هُوَ بِمُزَحۡزِحِهٖ مِنَ الۡعَذَابِ اَنۡ يُّعَمَّرَؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيۡرٌۭ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa latajidannahum ahrasannaasi 'alaa hayaatinw wa minal lazeena ashrakoo; yawaddu ahaduhum law yu'ammaru alfa sanatinw wa maa huwa bi muzahzihihee minal 'azaabi ai yu'ammar; wallaahu baseerum bimaa ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allah. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allah is Seeing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ مَنۡ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّجِبۡرِيۡلَ فَاِنَّهٗ نَزَّلَهٗ عَلٰي قَلۡبِكَ بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَهُدًي وَّبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul man kaana 'aduwwal li Jibreela fainnahoo nazzalahoo 'alaa qalbika bi iznil laahi musaddiqal limaa baina yadihi wa hudanw wa bushraa lilmu'mineen
ayahs.en: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought the Qur'an down upon your heart, [O Muhammad], by permission of Allah, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ عَدُوًّا لِّلّٰهِ وَمَلٰٓئِكَتِهٖ وَرُسُلِهٖ وَجِبۡرِيۡلَ وَمِيۡكٰىلَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَدُوٌّ لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Man kaana 'aduwwal lillaahi wa malaaa'ikatihee wa Rusulihee wa Jibreela wa Meekaala fa innal laaha 'aduwwul lilkaafireen
ayahs.en: Whoever is an enemy to Allah and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ اٰيٰتٍۭ بَيِّنٰتٍۚ وَمَا يَكۡفُرُ بِهَا٘ اِلَّا الۡفٰسِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad anzalnaaa ilaika Aayaatim baiyinaatinw wa maa yakfuru bihaaa illal faasiqoon
ayahs.en: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: اَوَكُلَّمَا عٰهَدُوۡا عَهۡدًا نَّبَذَهٗ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡهُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awa kullamaa 'aahadoo ahdan nabazahoo fareequm minhum; bal aksaruhum laa u'minoon
ayahs.en: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ مُصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَهُمۡ نَبَذَ فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَࣗۙ كِتٰبَ اللّٰهِ وَرَآءَ ظُهُوۡرِهِمۡ كَاَنَّهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jaaa'ahum Rasoolum min 'indil laahi musaddiqul limaa ma'ahum nabaza fareequm minal lazeena ootul Kitaaba Kitaabal laahi waraaa'a zuhoorihim ka annahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when a messenger from Allah came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allah behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَا تَتۡلُوا الشَّيٰطِيۡنُ عَلٰي مُلۡكِ سُلَيۡمٰنَۚ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيۡمٰنُ وَلٰكِنَّ الشَّيٰطِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يُعَلِّمُوۡنَ النَّاسَ السِّحۡرَࣗ وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَي الۡمَلَكَيۡنِ بِبَابِلَ هَارُوۡتَ وَمَارُوۡتَؕ وَمَا يُعَلِّمٰنِ مِنۡ اَحَدٍ حَتّٰي يَقُوۡلَا٘ اِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ فِتۡنَةٌ فَلَا تَكۡفُرۡؕ فَيَتَعَلَّمُوۡنَ مِنۡهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُوۡنَ بِهٖ بَيۡنَ الۡمَرۡءِ وَزَوۡجِهٖؕ وَمَا هُمۡ بِضَآرِّيۡنَ بِهٖ مِنۡ اَحَدٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ وَيَتَعَلَّمُوۡنَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ وَلَا يَنۡفَعُهُمۡؕ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمُوۡا لَمَنِ اشۡتَرٰىهُ مَا لَهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ مِنۡ خَلَاقٍؕࣞ وَلَبِئۡسَ مَا شَرَوۡا بِهٖ٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡؕ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wattaba'oo maa tatlush Shayaateenu 'alaa mulki Sulaimaana wa maa kafara Sulaimaanu wa laakinnash Shayattena kafaroo yu'al limoonan naasas sihra wa maaa unzila 'alal malakaini bi Baabila Haaroota wa Maaroot; wa maa yu'allimaani min ahadin hattaa yaqoolaaa innamaa nahnu fitnatun falaa takfur fayata'al lamoona minhumaa maa yufarriqoona bihee bainal mar'i wa zawjih; wa maa hum bidaaarreena bihee min ahadin illaa bi-iznillah; wa yata'allamoona maa yadurruhum wa laa yanfa'uhum; wa laqad 'alimoo lamanish taraahu maa lahoo fil Aakhirati min khalaaq; wa labi'sa maa sharaw biheee anfusahum; law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Harut and Marut. But the two angels do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allah. And the people learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But the Children of Israel certainly knew that whoever purchased the magic would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّقَوۡا لَمَثُوۡبَةٌ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌؕ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law annahum aamanoo wattaqaw lamasoobatum min 'indillaahi khairun law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And if they had believed and feared Allah, then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَقُوۡلُوۡا رَاعِنَا وَقُوۡلُوا انۡظُرۡنَا وَاسۡمَعُوۡاؕ وَلِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa taqooloo raa'inaa wa qoolun zurnaa wasma'oo; wa lilkaafireena 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, say not [to Allah 's Messenger], "Ra'ina" but say, "Unthurna" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: مَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ وَلَا الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ اَنۡ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ خَيۡرٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَاللّٰهُ ذُو الۡفَضۡلِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Maa yawaddul lazeena kafaroo min ahlil kitaabi wa lal mushrikeena ai-yunazzala 'alaikum min khairim mir Rabbikum; wallaahu yakhtassu birahmatihee mai-yashaaa; wallaahu zul fadlil'azeem
ayahs.en: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allah selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

ayahs.ar: مَا نَنۡسَخۡ مِنۡ اٰيَةٍ اَوۡ نُنۡسِهَا نَاۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍ مِّنۡهَا٘ اَوۡ مِثۡلِهَاؕ اَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Maa nansakh min aayatin aw nunsihaa na-ti bikhairim minhaaa aw mislihaaa; alam ta'lam annal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
ayahs.en: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allah is over all things competent?

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Alam ta'lam annallaaha lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wa maa lakum min doonil laahi minw waliyyinw wa laa naseer
ayahs.en: Do you not know that to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allah any protector or any helper?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ اَنۡ تَسۡـَٔلُوۡا رَسُوۡلَكُمۡ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوۡسٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ وَمَنۡ يَّتَبَدَّلِ الۡكُفۡرَ بِالۡاِيۡمَانِ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ السَّبِيۡلِ
ayahs.tl: Am tureedoona an tas'aloo Rasoolakum kamaa su'ila Moosa min qabl; wa mai yatabaddalil kufra bil eemaani faqad dalla sawaaa'as sabeel
ayahs.en: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.

ayahs.ar: وَدَّ كَثِيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ لَوۡ يَرُدُّوۡنَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اِيۡمَانِكُمۡ كُفَّارًاۚۖ حَسَدًا مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الۡحَقُّۚ فَاعۡفُوۡا وَاصۡفَحُوۡا حَتّٰي يَاۡتِيَ اللّٰهُ بِاَمۡرِهٖؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wadda kaseerum min ahlil kitaabi law yaruddoo nakum mim ba'di eemaanikum kuffaaran hasadam min 'indi anfusihim mim ba'di maa tabaiyana lahumul haqqu fa'foo washfahoo hattaa yaa tiyallaahu bi amrih; innal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer
ayahs.en: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allah delivers His command. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: وَاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَؕ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوۡا لِاَنۡفُسِكُمۡ مِّنۡ خَيۡرٍ تَجِدُوۡهُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaah; wa maa tuqaddimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laah; innal laaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer
ayahs.en: And establish prayer and give zakah, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. Indeed, Allah of what you do, is Seeing.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَنۡ يَّدۡخُلَ الۡجَنَّةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ كَانَ هُوۡدًا اَوۡ نَصٰرٰيؕ تِلۡكَ اَمَانِيُّهُمۡؕ قُلۡ هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo lai yadkhulal jannata illaa man kaana Hoodan aw Nasaaraa; tilka ammniyyuhum; qul haatoo burhaa nakum in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking, Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: بَلٰيࣗ مَنۡ اَسۡلَمَ وَجۡهَهٗ لِلّٰهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٌ فَلَهٗ٘ اَجۡرُهٗ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهٖࣕ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Balaa man aslama wajhahoo lillaahi wa huwa muhsinun falahooo ajruhoo 'inda rabbihee wa laa khawfun 'alaihim wa laa hum yahzanoon
ayahs.en: Yes [on the contrary], whoever submits his face in Islam to Allah while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَتِ الۡيَهُوۡدُ لَيۡسَتِ النَّصٰرٰي عَلٰي شَيۡءٍࣕ وَّقَالَتِ النَّصٰرٰي لَيۡسَتِ الۡيَهُوۡدُ عَلٰي شَيۡءٍۙ وَّهُمۡ يَتۡلُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَؕ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مِثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۚ فَاللّٰهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalatil Yahoodu laisatin Nasaaraa 'alaa shai'inw-wa qaalatin Nasaaraaa laisatil Yahoodu 'alaa shai'inw'wa hum yatloonal Kitaab; kazaalika qaalal lazeena la ya'lamoona misla qawlihim Yawmal Qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: The Jews say "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus the polytheists speak the same as their words. But Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ مَّنَعَ مَسٰجِدَ اللّٰهِ اَنۡ يُّذۡكَرَ فِيۡهَا اسۡمُهٗ وَسَعٰي فِيۡ خَرَابِهَاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡ يَّدۡخُلُوۡهَا٘ اِلَّا خَآئِفِيۡنَ ࣢ؕ لَهُمۡ فِي الدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٌ وَّلَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa man azlamu mimmam-mana'a masaajidal laahi ai-yuzkara feehas muhoo wa sa'aa fee kharaabihaaa; ulaaa'ika maa kaana lahum ai yadkhuloohaaa illaa khaaa''feen; lahum fiddunyaa khizyunw wa lahum fil aakhirati 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allah from being mentioned in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ الۡمَشۡرِقُ وَالۡمَغۡرِبُࣗ فَاَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّوۡا فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahil mashriqu walmaghrib; fa aynamaa tuwalloo fasamma wajhullaah; innal laaha waasi'un Aleem
ayahs.en: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًاۙ سُبۡحٰنَهٗؕ بَلۡ لَّهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalut takhazal laahu waladan subhaanahoo bal lahoo maa fis samaawaati wal ardi kullul lahoo qaanitoon
ayahs.en: They say, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him,

ayahs.ar: بَدِيۡعُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Badree'us samaawaati wal ardi wa izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.en: Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ لَوۡلَا يُكَلِّمُنَا اللّٰهُ اَوۡ تَاۡتِيۡنَا٘ اٰيَةٌؕ كَذٰلِكَ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡؕ تَشَابَهَتۡ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡؕ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يُّوۡقِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena laa ya'lamoona law laa yukallimunal laahu aw taateenaaa aayah; kazaalika qaalal lazeena min qablihim misla qawlihim; tashaabahat quloobuhum; qad baiyannal aayaati liqawminy yooqinoon
ayahs.en: Those who do not know say, "Why does Allah not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَقِّ بَشِيۡرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًاۙ وَّلَا تُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ اَصۡحٰبِ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Innaaa arsalnaaka bilhaqqi basheeranw wa nazeeranw wa laa tus'alu 'am Ashaabil Jaheem
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: وَلَنۡ تَرۡضٰي عَنۡكَ الۡيَهُوۡدُ وَلَا النَّصٰرٰي حَتّٰي تَتَّبِعَ مِلَّتَهُمۡؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ هُدَي اللّٰهِ هُوَ الۡهُدٰيؕ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعۡتَ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ بَعۡدَ الَّذِيۡ جَآءَكَ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِۙ مَا لَكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا نَصِيۡرٍؔ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lan tardaa 'ankal Yahoodu wa lan Nasaaraa hattaa tattabi'a millatahum; qul inna hudal laahi huwalhudaa; wa la'init taba'ta ahwaaa'ahum ba'dal lazee jaaa'aka minal 'ilmimaa laka minal laahi minw waliyyinw wa laa naseer
ayahs.en: And never will the Jews or the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allah is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allah no protector or helper.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ يَتۡلُوۡنَهٗ حَقَّ تِلَاوَتِهٖؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرۡ بِهٖ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena aatainaahumul Kitaaba yatloonahoo haqqa tilaawatiheee ulaaa'ika yu'minoona bi; wa mai yakfur bihee fa ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon
ayahs.en: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital. They [are the ones who] believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers.

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتِيَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَاَنِّيۡ فَضَّلۡتُكُمۡ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eelaz-kuroo ni'matiyal lateee an'amtu 'alaikum wa annee faddaltukum 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّقُوۡا يَوۡمًا لَّا تَجۡزِيۡ نَفۡسٌ عَنۡ نَّفۡسٍ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يُقۡبَلُ مِنۡهَا عَدۡلٌ وَّلَا تَنۡفَعُهَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wattaqoo yawmal laa tajzee nafsun 'an nafsin shai 'anw wa laa yuqbalu minhaa 'adlunw wa laa tanfa'uhaa shafaa 'atunw wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذِ ابۡتَلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهٖمَ رَبُّهٗ بِكَلِمٰتٍ فَاَتَمَّهُنَّؕ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ جَاعِلُكَ لِلنَّاسِ اِمَامًاؕ قَالَ وَمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِيۡؕ قَالَ لَا يَنَالُ عَهۡدِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izib talaaa Ibraaheema Rabbuho bi Kalimaatin fa atammahunna qaala Innee jaa'iluka linnaasi Imaaman qaala wa min zurriyyatee qaala laa yanaalu 'ahdiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with commands and he fulfilled them. [Allah] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allah] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ جَعَلۡنَا الۡبَيۡتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَاَمۡنًاؕ وَاتَّخِذُوۡا مِنۡ مَّقَامِ اِبۡرٰهٖمَ مُصَلًّيؕ وَعَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهٖمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ اَنۡ طَهِّرَا بَيۡتِيَ لِلطَّآئِفِيۡنَ وَالۡعٰكِفِيۡنَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُوۡدِ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz ja'alnal Baita masaabatal linnassi wa amnanw wattakhizoo mim Maqaami Ibraaheema musallaaa; wa 'ahidnaaa ilaaa Ibraaheema wa Ismaa'eela an tahhiraa Baitiya littaaa'ifeena wal'aakifeena warrukka'is sujood
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهٖمُ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ هٰذَا بَلَدًا اٰمِنًا وَّارۡزُقۡ اَهۡلَهٗ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ مَنۡ اٰمَنَ مِنۡهُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِؕ قَالَ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاُمَتِّعُهٗ قَلِيۡلًا ثُمَّ اَضۡطَرُّهٗ٘ اِلٰي عَذَابِ النَّارِؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaala Ibraaheemu Rabbij 'al haazaa baladan aaminanw warzuq ahlahoo minas samaraati man aamana minhum billaahi wal yawmil aakhiri qaala wa man kafara faumatti'uhoo qaleelan summa adtarruhooo ilaa 'azaabin Naari wa bi'salmaseer
ayahs.en: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allah and the Last Day." [Allah] said. "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ يَرۡفَعُ اِبۡرٰهٖمُ الۡقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الۡبَيۡتِ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلُؕ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّاؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz yarfa'u Ibraaheemul qawaa'ida minal Baitiwa Ismaa'eelu Rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas Samee'ul Aleem
ayahs.en: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَيۡنِ لَكَ وَمِنۡ ذُرِّيَّتِنَا٘ اُمَّةً مُّسۡلِمَةً لَّكَࣕ وَاَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبۡ عَلَيۡنَاۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimaini laka wa min zurriyyatinaaa ummatam muslimatal laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub 'alainaa innaka antat Tawwaabur Raheem
ayahs.en: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا وَابۡعَثۡ فِيۡهِمۡ رَسُوۡلًا مِّنۡهُمۡ يَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِكَ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡحِكۡمَةَ وَيُزَكِّيۡهِمۡؕ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaa wab'as feehim Rasoolam minhum yatloo 'alaihim aayaatika wa yu'allimuhumul Kitaaba wal Hikmata wa yuzakkeehim; innaka Antal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّرۡغَبُ عَنۡ مِّلَّةِ اِبۡرٰهٖمَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَفِهَ نَفۡسَهٗؕ وَلَقَدِ اصۡطَفَيۡنٰهُ فِي الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَاِنَّهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa manny yarghabu 'am-Millarti Ibraaheema illaa man safiha nafsah; wa laqadis tafainaahu fid-dunyaa wa innaho fil aakhirati laminas saaliheen
ayahs.en: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَهٗ رَبُّهٗ٘ اَسۡلِمۡۙ قَالَ اَسۡلَمۡتُ لِرَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala lahoo Rabbuhooo aslim qaala aslamtu li Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: When his Lord said to him, "Submit", he said "I have submitted [in Islam] to the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: وَوَصّٰي بِهَا٘ اِبۡرٰهٖمُ بَنِيۡهِ وَيَعۡقُوۡبُؕ يٰبَنِيَّ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصۡطَفٰي لَكُمُ الدِّيۡنَ فَلَا تَمُوۡتُنَّ اِلَّا وَاَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa wassaa bihaaa Ibraaheemu baneehi wa Ya'qoob, yaa baniyya innal laahas tafaa lakumud deena falaa tamootunna illaa wa antum muslimoon
ayahs.en: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ شُهَدَآءَ اِذۡ حَضَرَ يَعۡقُوۡبَ الۡمَوۡتُۙ اِذۡ قَالَ لِبَنِيۡهِ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِيۡؕ قَالُوۡا نَعۡبُدُ اِلٰهَكَ وَاِلٰهَ اٰبَآئِكَ اِبۡرٰهٖمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ اِلٰهًا وَّاحِدًاۚۖ وَّنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am kuntum shuhadaaa'a iz hadara Ya'qoobal mawtu iz qaala libaneehi maa ta'budoona mim ba'dee qaaloo na'budu ilaahaka wa ilaaha aabaaa'ika Ibraaheema wa Ismaa'eela wa Ishaaqa Ilaahanw waahidanw wa nahnu lahoo muslimoon
ayahs.en: Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac - one God. And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ اُمَّةٌ قَدۡ خَلَتۡۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَلَكُمۡ مَّا كَسَبۡتُمۡۚ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahaa maa kasabat wa lakum maa kasabtum wa laa tus'aloona 'ammaa kaano ya'maloon
ayahs.en: That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا كُوۡنُوۡا هُوۡدًا اَوۡ نَصٰرٰي تَهۡتَدُوۡاؕ قُلۡ بَلۡ مِلَّةَ اِبۡرٰهٖمَ حَنِيۡفًاؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo koonoo Hoodan aw Nasaaraa tahtadoo; qul bal Millata Ibraaheema Haneefanw wa maa kaana minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: They say, "Be Jews or Christians [so] you will be guided." Say, "Rather, [we follow] the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists."

ayahs.ar: قُوۡلُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡنَا وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ اِلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهٖمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَالۡاَسۡبَاطِ وَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ مُوۡسٰي وَعِيۡسٰي وَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ النَّبِيُّوۡنَ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡۚ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنۡهُمۡؗ وَنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qoolooo aamannaa billaahi wa maaa unzila ilainaa wa maaa unzila ilaaa Ibraaheema wa Ismaa'eela wa Ishaaqa wa Ya'qooba wal Asbaati wa maaootiya Moosa wa 'Eesaa wa maaa ootiyan Nabiyyoona mir Rabbihim laa nufaariq baina ahadim minhum wa nahnu lahoo muslimoon
ayahs.en: Say, [O believers], "We have believed in Allah and what has been revealed to us and what has been revealed to Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants and what was given to Moses and Jesus and what was given to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ اٰمَنُوۡا بِمِثۡلِ مَا٘ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ فَقَدِ اهۡتَدَوۡاۚ وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّمَا هُمۡ فِيۡ شِقَاقٍۚ فَسَيَكۡفِيۡكَهُمُ اللّٰهُۚ وَهُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa in aamanoo bimisli maaa aamantum bihee faqadih tadaw wa in tawallaw fa innamaa hum fee shiqaaq; fasayakfeekahumul laah; wa Huwas Samee'ul Aleem
ayahs.en: So if they believe in the same as you believe in, then they have been [rightly] guided; but if they turn away, they are only in dissension, and Allah will be sufficient for you against them. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: صِبۡغَةَ اللّٰهِۚ وَمَنۡ اَحۡسَنُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ صِبۡغَةًؗ وَّنَحۡنُ لَهٗ عٰبِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sibghatal laahi wa man ahsanu minal laahi sibghatanw wa nahnu lahoo 'aabidoon
ayahs.en: [And say, "Ours is] the religion of Allah. And who is better than Allah in [ordaining] religion? And we are worshippers of Him."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَتُحَآجُّوۡنَنَا فِي اللّٰهِ وَهُوَ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡۚ وَلَنَا٘ اَعۡمَالُنَا وَلَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالُكُمۡۚ وَنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُخۡلِصُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul atuhaaajjoonanaa fil laahi wa Huwa Rabbunaa wa Rabbukum wa lanaa a'maalunaa wa lakum a'maalukum wa nahnu lahoo mukhlisson
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Do you argue with us about Allah while He is our Lord and your Lord? For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. And we are sincere [in deed and intention] to Him."

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهٖمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَالۡاَسۡبَاطَ كَانُوۡا هُوۡدًا اَوۡ نَصٰرٰيؕ قُلۡ ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ اَمِ اللّٰهُؕ وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ كَتَمَ شَهَادَةً عِنۡدَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am taqooloona inna Ibraaheema wa Ismaa'eela wa Ishaaq wa Ya'qooba wal asbaata kaanoo Hoodan aw Nasaaraa; qul 'a-antum a'lamu amil laah; wa man azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan 'indahoo minallaah; wa mallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Or do you say that Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac and Jacob and the Descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, "Are you more knowing or is Allah?" And who is more unjust than one who conceals a testimony he has from Allah? And Allah is not unaware of what you do.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ اُمَّةٌ قَدۡ خَلَتۡۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَلَكُمۡ مَّا كَسَبۡتُمۡۚ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُوۡنَ عَمَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Tilka ummatun qad khalat lahaa maa kasabat wa lakum maa kasabtum wa laa tus'aloona 'ammaa kaano ya'maloo
ayahs.en: That is a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُوۡلُ السُّفَهَآءُ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَا وَلّٰىهُمۡ عَنۡ قِبۡلَتِهِمُ الَّتِيۡ كَانُوۡا عَلَيۡهَاؕ قُلۡ لِّلّٰهِ الۡمَشۡرِقُ وَالۡمَغۡرِبُؕ يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Sayaqoolus sufahaaa'u minan naasi maa wallaahum 'an Qiblatihimul latee kaanoo 'alaihaa; qulo lillaahil mashriqu walmaghrib; yahdee mai yashaaa'u ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?" Say, "To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنٰكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّسَطًا لِّتَكُوۡنُوۡا شُهَدَآءَ عَلَي النَّاسِ وَيَكُوۡنَ الرَّسُوۡلُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ شَهِيۡدًاؕ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا الۡقِبۡلَةَ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتَ عَلَيۡهَا٘ اِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَنۡ يَّتَّبِعُ الرَّسُوۡلَ مِمَّنۡ يَّنۡقَلِبُ عَلٰي عَقِبَيۡهِؕ وَاِنۡ كَانَتۡ لَكَبِيۡرَةً اِلَّا عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ هَدَي اللّٰهُؕ وَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيُضِيۡعَ اِيۡمَانَكُمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika ja'alnaakum ummatanw wasatal litakoonoo shuhadaaa'a 'alan naasi wa yakoonar Rasoolu 'alaikum shaheedaa; wa maa ja'alnal qiblatal latee kunta 'alaihaaa illaa lina'lama mai yattabi'ur Rasoola mimmai yanqalibu 'alaa 'aqibayh; wa in kaanat lakabeeratan illaa 'alal lazeena hadal laah; wa maa kaanal laahu liyudee'a eemaanakum; innal laaha binnaasi la Ra'oofur Raheem
ayahs.en: And thus we have made you a just community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels. And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allah has guided. And never would Allah have caused you to lose your faith. Indeed Allah is, to the people, Kind and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ نَرٰي تَقَلُّبَ وَجۡهِكَ فِي السَّمَآءِۚ فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ قِبۡلَةً تَرۡضٰىهَاࣕ فَوَلِّ وَجۡهَكَ شَطۡرَ الۡمَسۡجِدِ الۡحَرَامِؕ وَحَيۡثُ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ فَوَلُّوۡا وُجُوۡهَكُمۡ شَطۡرَهٗؕ وَاِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ لَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ اَنَّهُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qad naraa taqalluba wajhika fis samaaa'i fala nuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardaahaa; fawalli wajhaka shatral Masjidil haaraam; wa haisu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrah; wa innal lazeena ootul Kitaaba laya'lamoona annahul haqqu mir Rabbihim; wa mal laahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ya'maloon
ayahs.en: We have certainly seen the turning of your face, [O Muhammad], toward the heaven, and We will surely turn you to a qiblah with which you will be pleased. So turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram. And wherever you [believers] are, turn your faces toward it [in prayer]. Indeed, those who have been given the Scripture well know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allah is not unaware of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَتَيۡتَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ بِكُلِّ اٰيَةٍ مَّا تَبِعُوۡا قِبۡلَتَكَۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِتَابِعٍ قِبۡلَتَهُمۡۚ وَمَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ بِتَابِعٍ قِبۡلَةَ بَعۡضٍؕ وَلَئِنِ اتَّبَعۡتَ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِۙ اِنَّكَ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la'in ataital lazeena ootul kitaaba bikulli aayatim maa tabi'oo Qiblatak; wa maaa anta bitaabi'in Qiblatahum; wa maa ba'duhum bitaabi''in Qiblata ba'd; wa la'init taba'ta ahwaaa;ahum mim ba'di maa jaaa'aka minal 'ilmi innaka izal laminaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: And if you brought to those who were given the Scripture every sign, they would not follow your qiblah. Nor will you be a follower of their qiblah. Nor would they be followers of one another's qiblah. So if you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, indeed, you would then be among the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ يَعۡرِفُوۡنَهٗ كَمَا يَعۡرِفُوۡنَ اَبۡنَآءَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّ فَرِيۡقًا مِّنۡهُمۡ لَيَكۡتُمُوۡنَ الۡحَقَّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَؔ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena aatainaahumul kitaaba ya'rifoonahoo kamaa ya'rifoona abnaaa'ahum wa inna fareeqam minhum layaktumoonal haqqa wa hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture know him as they know their own sons. But indeed, a party of them conceal the truth while they know [it].

ayahs.ar: اَلۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُمۡتَرِيۡنَࣖ‏
